title: Australian Sausage Pie
description: A hearty and savory pie filled with Australian sausage, perfect for a cold winter night. Made with a flaky crust and topped with a sprinkle of cheese.
instructions: Roll out pie crust and place in a 9-inch pie dish.
Cook sausage in a pan over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add onion, garlic, and mushrooms to the pan and cook until the vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Pour the sausage and vegetable mixture into the pie crust.
Top the pie with shredded cheese.
Bake the pie in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
Serve the pie hot, garnished with chopped herbs if desired.
